title: List the nets selected in the CAMtastic viewer
summary: Identifies the active document and its editor server with IServerDocument.GetKind and GetServerModule to check for a CAMtastic document, and documents that the .NET SDK has no API for CAMtastic net selections.
phrasings: check if the active document is a CAM document
get the kind of the focused document
find which server owns a document

commands.name: GetSelectedNets
commands.description: Report the nets selected in the active CAMtastic document
